Twin Nemesis.description: Two beasts sharing one axis and refusing to share anything else. One head takes the hit, the other answers it, and the blade is never doing both at once — which is exactly why it never runs out of the one it needs.

special_move.name: Twin Fang Devour
special_move.description: Both heads come off the axis at once and close from opposite sides. There is no gap between the two bites to step out of.
flavour_texts: 🐍 **Twin Fang Devour** — both heads close at once!

abilities.name: Beast Alternation
abilities.description: The heads trade off. Every strike takes **6 stability** and banks a Fang; at **3 Fangs** the second head bites for **85** and the count resets. Meanwhile every hit taken is answered with **12% reduction and 16 reflected** — whichever head is not attacking is guarding.

Deep Caynox.name: Deep Caynox
Deep Caynox.description: It sits so low the stadium floor barely knows it is there. Deep Caynox has the weakest strike of any Legendary and does not need a better one — it puts its spin behind the blow instead of its edge, and outlasts anything that tries to out-hit it.

special_move.name: Levitation Launch
special_move.description: Caynox lifts clear of the floor entirely and stops touching anything. No damage, none intended — it comes back down with its spin restored and its footing back.
flavour_texts: 🌀 **Levitation Launch** — Caynox leaves the floor entirely!

abilities.name: Switch Strike
abilities.description:
Caynox switches which stat does the hitting: every Attack adds **45% of its Stamina** as damage, which on a 121-Stamina blade is worth more than its whole Attack stat. It also drains **0.5 stamina** from whoever hits it and cuts **10%** off that hit.
**Levitation Launch** deals no damage at all — instead it restores **26 HP**, **2 stamina** and **20 stability**, and leaves a **60 HP shield** with **+45 Defence for 2 turns**.

Deep Caynox ELT.name: Deep Caynox ELT
Deep Caynox ELT.description: The same low disc, tuned past the point the standard release stops at. ELT does not switch which stat strikes — it stops distinguishing between them. Every point of spin is a point of edge, and the levitation comes back down heavier than it left.

abilities.name: Extreme Switch Strike
abilities.description:
Switch Strike, taken further. Every Attack adds **70% of its Stamina** as damage; it drains **0.9 stamina** from whoever hits it and cuts **18%** off that hit, and every third hit taken answers for **60**.
**Levitation Launch** restores **44 HP**, **3 stamina** and **30 stability**, leaves a **110 HP shield** with **+70 Defence for 3 turns**, and puts **+25 Attack** behind the next two strikes.

special_move.name: Levitation Launch
special_move.description: Caynox lifts clear of the floor entirely and stops touching anything. No damage, none intended — it comes back down with its spin restored and its footing back.
flavour_texts: 🌀 **Levitation Launch** — ELT does not come back down the same!

Surge Xcalius.name: Surge Xcalius
Surge Xcalius.description: A sword that has forgotten how to be anything else. Surge Xcalius cannot recover and cannot guard — the recovery comes out as a strike and the guard comes out as a counter, because the blade has no other gear to shift into. 47 Defence is not a weakness it carries; it is the weight it threw away.

special_move.name: Triple Saber
special_move.description: Three sabers out of one edge, each one aimed at the footing rather than the blade. Thirty points of stability leave the stadium across the set.
flavour_texts: ⚔️ **Triple Saber** — three cuts, and none of them at the blade!

abilities.name: Surge Overwrite
abilities.description:
Every defensive option is rewritten as an attack.
• **Recover** stops restoring and lands **59 damage** instead.
• **Defend** stops soaking and counters **20% harder**, off the normal defence-counter calculation.
• The **Special** lands **3 sabers at 10 stability each** and banks the 30. The NEXT Special cashes that bank for **230 damage** and banks again, so from the second one onward every Special collects.

rules._note: on_hit is the per-Special-hit trigger — 3 hits x 10 = the same 30 the single-hit version took.

Heaven's Ring.name: Heaven's Ring
Heaven's Ring.description: A halo given form. Heaven's Ring answers every blow with divine absorption, turning the force of an attack back on the one who threw it.

ability.name: Divine
ability.description: Absorption. Damage resistance 7% stacking up to 5 times, and critical damage resistance 2% stacking up to 5 times.

abilities.name: Divine
abilities.description: Absorption. Damage resistance 7% stacking up to 5 times, and critical damage resistance 2% stacking up to 5 times.

abilities.name: Angelic Counter
abilities.description: 30% chance to reflect 55% of the damage dealt back to its attacker.

abilities.name: Holy Bague
abilities.description: Gains a shield worth 10% of current HP, and a 1.5x damage boost for 4 turns.

special_move.name: Holy Bague
special_move.description: Heaven's Ring gains a shield worth 10% of its current HP and a 1.5x damage boost for 4 turns, then strikes twice.
flavour_texts: 😇 **Holy Bague** — the ring flares, and the halo closes!
✨ **Hit 2** — divine light breaks over the opponent!
